name: roc-startup-week-collateral
description: Repeatable HTML-to-PNG/PDF marketing collateral pipeline for Roc Startup Week

scripts.export:events: npm run sync:schedule && npm run fetch:headshots && node scripts/export-collateral.js --events
scripts.export: npm run sync:schedule && npm run fetch:headshots && npm run brand-assets && npm run export:collateral
scripts.build: npm run export && npm run build:site
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.production.jsonc
scripts.check: node tests/marquee-seam.test.js && node tests/schedule-headliner-hover.test.js && npm run build:site
